title: Take your time and savor...
text: Take your time and savor the sangria and enjoy the view especially at sunset. Ask questions to learn more.
author: Kim_Y

title: Lived Up to its Ratings!
text: Really enjoyed a different type of outing than the normal and this fit the bill completely. We had an engaging hostess who offered great information on the different tastings with delicious tapas. The review of the river along with old town just added to event. Such a bargain too.
author: Michelle_h

title: An Exceptional Experience in the Heart of Sevilla
text: We had such an exceptional experience with Antonio. He made us all feel incredibly welcome and did a phenomenal job of balancing engaging information & history about Spain with levity & lightness, which allowed us to connect well with other folks on our tour. It also helped that the wine, the food, and the views were all spectacular and set the perfect note on a lovely trip to Sevilla. I'd highly recommend this tour to family, friends, and just about everyone!
author: PapaBearsauce

title: Delicious Sangrias and Amazing View
text: I've done this activity along with a couple of others through Local Food Experiences and could not have enjoyed it more. The Sangrias were delicious, and the guides perfectly explained the history and importance of the sangrias. The atmosphere was super welcoming, and the view was unmatched. I have recommended this activity to other friends and family visiting Sevilla, who also had a blast. Will definitely be back!
author: gigiyyoung

title: Excellent products, even better views!
text: I wanted to rest from the April Fair while still enjoying Seville. I already knew the company for its Tapas Tour in the Triana Market and that is why I trusted them for this activity. The views from the Terrace are impressive, it seems as if you could touch the Torre del Oro. The guides, once again fantastic. A very very good service.
author: suricatocap

title: A 10!!
text: A spectacular experience! In addition to the sangrias we had the opportunity to try traditional Seville tapas while we saw the entire city! It was wonderful, and the guide who assisted us was very attentive and very knowledgeable! A 10!!
author: Juliacharlo
